mechanism.does_not_replace: payloadio owns LOCAL payload atomicity (ADR-0088, tmp+rename); object stores are atomic on PUT. Two layers, two contracts — storageport stores documents and media, payloadio lands the proof payloads
mechanism.license: Apache-2.0 — clears the license doctrine (no BSL/SSPL/Elastic, no GPL/AGPL contamination)
mechanism.main_not_optional: the suite pins ADAPTER == 'opendal': if the main engine is absent the gate goes red and names it; the stdlib path is declared degraded mode, fs/memory only, stamped on every receipt
mechanism.what: one storage port over every object backend; Apache OpenDAL is the MAIN engine — fs, memory and cloud schemes all run through opendal when it is importable
mechanism.why: a deployment target is a registry entry, never a code branch — ministry server room (fs), clinic process (memory), cloud archive (s3) are configuration; retry is a layer and its policy is data; range reads resume an interrupted transfer at the offset instead of restarting from byte zero — the low-bandwidth contract

registry_scope.credentials: never values in the registry — they arrive via secrets= at connect time; a required key without a secret is a stated refusal, pre-network
